questions.title: Sorted Pair Sum Check
questions.description:
The two-pointer pattern shines on sorted arrays: park one index at each end and move them toward each other based on how the current sum compares with the target. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int pairSumExists(int[] sorted, int target)

sorted is in non-decreasing order. It must return 1 when two elements at DIFFERENT indices sum exactly to target, otherwise 0.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N non-decreasing values. Line 3: target.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
2 <= N <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000, -2000 <= target <= 2000

questions.title: Window Peak Sum
questions.description:
A metrics dashboard computes the busiest stretch of a feed by sliding a fixed-size window across the series and keeping the largest window total. The sliding-window sum updates in O(1) per step: add the entering value, drop the leaving one. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int maxWindowSum(int[] values, int k)

It must return the maximum sum of any k consecutive values.

Input Format:
Line 1: N K. Line 2: N values.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum window sum.

Constraints:
1 <= K <= N <= 50, 0 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Merge Sorted Logs
questions.description:
A log shipper receives two sorted streams and must emit one merged sorted stream — the merge step of merge sort, driven by two pointers that always advance the smaller head. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int[] mergeSorted(int[] a, int[] b)

Both inputs are non-decreasing. It must return their non-decreasing merge of length a.length + b.length.

Input Format:
Line 1: N M. Line 2: N values of a. Line 3: M values of b.

Output Format:
One line with the merged array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N, M <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000, each input array is non-decreasing
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= N, M <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000, each input array is non-decreasing

questions.title: Range Sum Query
questions.description:
Prefix sums turn any range query into one subtraction: precompute running totals once, then answer sum(l..r) as pre[r+1] - pre[l]. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int rangeSum(int[] values, int l, int r)

It must return the sum of values[l] through values[r] inclusive (0-indexed).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N values. Line 3: l r.

Output Format:
One line with the range sum.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, 0 <= value <= 1000, 0 <= l <= r < N

questions.title: Reverse With Two Pointers
questions.description:
Reversing in place is the two-pointer warm-up: swap the outer pair, step both pointers inward, stop when they meet. No second array is needed. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void reverseArray(int[] a)

It must reverse a in place (the provided harness prints the array afterwards).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N values.

Output Format:
One line with the reversed array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Power of Two Check
questions.description:
A power of two has exactly one bit set, so n & (n - 1) wipes that bit and leaves zero — the classic one-line bit trick (guard n <= 0 first). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int isPowerOfTwo(int n)

It must return 1 when n is a positive power of two (1, 2, 4, 8, ...), otherwise 0.

Input Format:
One line: n.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 2000000000

questions.title: Left Rotate By One
questions.description:
Rotating an array by one is a staple warm-up: remember the first element, shift everything left, park the saved value at the end — all in place. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void rotateLeft(int[] a)

It must rotate a left by one position in place (the harness prints the array afterwards).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N values.

Output Format:
One line with the rotated array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Conveyor Min Window
questions.description:
A conveyor-belt monitor wants the calmest stretch of readings: the k consecutive samples with the smallest total load. Same sliding window as the max-sum variant, flipped to the minimum. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int minWindowSum(int[] values, int k)

It must return the minimum sum of any k consecutive values.

Input Format:
Line 1: N K. Line 2: N values.

Output Format:
One line with the minimum window sum.

Constraints:
1 <= K <= N <= 50, 0 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Even Traffic Count
questions.description:
A traffic dashboard answers "how many even readings occurred between hour l and hour r?" thousands of times a day. Precomputing a prefix count of even values makes each query a subtraction. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int evenCountInRange(int[] readings, int l, int r)

It must return how many readings in indices l..r inclusive are even.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N readings. Line 3: l r.

Output Format:
One line with the count.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, 0 <= reading <= 1000000, 0 <= l <= r < N

questions.title: Even Parity Badge Count
questions.description:
Access badges carry a parity bit: a badge ID is "even parity" when its binary form has an even number of 1-bits (zero bits counts as even). Counting set bits with Brian Kernighan's trick (x &= x - 1) clears the lowest set bit each round. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int countEvenParity(int[] ids)

It must return how many ids have even parity.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N badge ids.

Output Format:
One line with the count.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, 0 <= id <= 2000000000

questions.title: Unique Badge XOR
questions.description:
A conference reprints every attendee badge exactly twice — except one visitor whose badge was printed once. Pairing duplicates cancels them under XOR (x ^ x = 0), so a single accumulator over the array isolates the unique badge in O(n) time and O(1) space. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int uniqueBadge(int[] badges)

Every value appears exactly twice except one; it must return that value.

Input Format:
Line 1: N (odd). Line 2: N badge values.

Output Format:
One line with the unique value.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 60 and N is odd, 0 <= value <= 2000000000, every value appears exactly twice except exactly one

questions.title: Peak Signal Subarray
questions.description:
A telemetry stream mixes positive and negative sensor deltas; engineers want the contiguous stretch with the highest total signal. Kadane's scan keeps the best subarray ENDING here (extend or restart) and the best seen anywhere — and with magnitudes near 1.5 billion, partial sums overflow int, so run the totals in long. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long maxSubarraySum(int[] values)

The subarray must contain at least one element (an all-negative array answers with its largest element).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N deltas.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum subarray sum.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, -1500000000 <= value <= 1500000000

questions.title: Set Bits From One To N
questions.description:
A firmware team needs the total number of 1-bits written when the integers 1..n are burned into memory. Summing popcounts per integer with Brian Kernighan's bit-clearing loop gives an exact census; the total quickly outgrows int, so count in long. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long countTotalSetBits(int n)

It must return the total number of set bits across all integers from 1 to n inclusive.

Input Format:
One line: n.

Output Format:
One line with the total set-bit count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Missing Roll Number
questions.description:
A course roster should list every roll number 0..n exactly once, but one entry went missing. The sum formula n*(n+1)/2 minus the actual total reveals the gap instantly — use long so big rosters cannot overflow. (An XOR pass over indices and values finds it just as well.) The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long missingNumber(int[] values)

values holds n distinct numbers from the range 0..n with exactly one missing; it must return the missing number.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N distinct numbers from the range 0..N.

Output Format:
One line with the missing number.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100000

questions.title: Download Budget Window
questions.description:
A download manager streams consecutive chunks while their total size stays within the user's budget; it wants the LONGEST such run of chunks. With non-negative sizes, the classic two-pointer sliding window grows the right edge and shrinks the left only when the budget is exceeded. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int longestBudgetWindow(int[] sizes, int budget)

It must return the length of the longest contiguous run whose sum is at most budget (0 when no single chunk fits).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N chunk sizes. Line 3: budget.

Output Format:
One line with the longest run length.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, 0 <= size <= 1000, 0 <= budget <= 50000

questions.title: Equilibrium Index
questions.description:
A load balancer looks for the pivot server whose left traffic equals its right traffic: index i is an equilibrium when values[0..i-1] and values[i+1..n-1] have equal sums. One total pass plus a running left sum decides it without recomputing ranges. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int equilibriumIndex(int[] values)

It must return the SMALLEST equilibrium index, or -1 when none exists.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N values.

Output Format:
One line with the smallest equilibrium index or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Water Tank Max Area
questions.description:
Two dock walls of different heights hold water between them; the trapped area is min(height_left, height_right) times the gap. Starting with the widest gap and walking the pointers inward — always dropping the shorter wall — provably visits the best pair. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int maxWaterArea(int[] walls)

It must return the maximum water area over all pairs of walls.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N wall heights.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum water area.

Constraints:
2 <= N <= 50, 1 <= height <= 10000

questions.title: Voting Majority Check
questions.description:
A poll validator accepts a tally only when one option strictly exceeds half of all votes. Boyer-Moore voting cancels out pairs of different options to surface a candidate in one pass — then a second pass must VERIFY the candidate, otherwise a split vote yields a false winner. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int majorityElement(int[] votes)

It must return the value occurring more than N/2 times, or -1 when no majority exists.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N vote values.

Output Format:
One line with the majority value or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, 0 <= vote <= 1000000000

questions.title: Dutch Flag Partition
questions.description:
A warehouse sorter must partition bins of three colours (0, 1, 2) IN PLACE with a single sweep — the Dutch national flag problem. Three pointers (low, mid, high) push 0s to the front, 2s to the back and leave 1s in the middle without any library sort. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void flagSort(int[] bins)

bins contains only 0s, 1s and 2s; it must rearrange bins into non-decreasing order in place (the harness prints the array afterwards).

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N values, each 0, 1 or 2.

Output Format:
One line with the partitioned array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 50, each value is 0, 1 or 2

questions.title: Best Stock Profit Day
questions.description:
A trader reviews a day's prices and wants the largest single gain from buying at hour i and selling LATER at hour j (j > i). Scanning once while tracking the cheapest price so far yields the best difference in O(n); when prices only fall, no profitable pair exists and the answer is -1. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long maxPriceJump(int[] prices)

It must return the maximum prices[j] - prices[i] over j > i, or -1 when no positive difference exists.

Input Format:
Line 1: N. Line 2: N prices.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum gain, or -1.

Constraints:
2 <= N <= 50, 1 <= price <= 2000000000
